red.falseMention: The pre-change analyzer used substring matching, so echo/cat mentions and same-name directories were accepted as helper execution.
red.implicitApi: The pre-change analyzer inserted api-task-solidify.js when no entrypoint was declared.
red.exitAndAssertion: The pre-change analyzer treated a non-structured exit-zero output as helper failure instead of separating normal exit from output assertion.
red.ambiguousShell: The pre-change analyzer accepted a helper path inside a compound shell command; the red case requires an unknown result.

matching.shellPolicy: Only a single unambiguous command is matched; pipes, redirects, command separators, eval flags and nested shells remain unknown.
matching.pathPolicy: Compare canonical complete paths after stripping only declared/conventional skill roots; arbitrary directory prefixes are never collapsed.
matching.entrypointSource: Selected package implementation entries; an absent declaration yields an empty set, not an API-specific default.

separation.taskQuality: taskQuality/taskOutcome supplied by independent task checks
separation.mechanicalCounts: skill read, help, entrypoint discovery, program rewrite, and program execution IDs/counts

unknownPolicy: Unknown exit or ambiguous invocation is retained by tool-call ID and cannot prove helper success; a plain exit-zero output is normal exit plus unknown assertion, not failure or quality pass.
claimBoundary: F7 is deterministic local development evidence. It improves observation of ordinary non-API consumption but does not establish model behavior, whole-skill correctness, effect, readiness, human savings, prospective eligibility, or held-out performance.
